accounting.quantile: p25 of the signed move (the adverse side)

justification: Measured on our own 43,876 real sells (p25 adverse shortfall vs the mint's trailing 20-fill mark) and 72,697 <=3s retry windows; the Rust Mode-C numbers (200/300/50bp) are test fixtures for a DIFFERENT cost model whose fixed leg was already measured ~15x our real cost, and adopting them would charge 3x our measured adverse exit and make every exit unprofitable by construction. Robustness comes from the LEVEL, not from a floor on the measurement: training charges these measured-adverse values, the gate and evaluation charge the pessimistic (2x) level.
